summary: First-time end-to-end MatchPoint test. Backend: 28/29 pytest tests pass (96.5%). Found & fixed a CRITICAL timezone-comparison bug in OTP flows (verify-email/verify-2fa/reset-password) that returned 500 Internal Server Error — MongoDB returned tz-naive datetimes while utcnow() was tz-aware. Introduced helper _otp_expired() and replaced 3 comparisons. Remaining backend failure: Stripe /api/wallet/deposit returns 500 because STRIPE_API_KEY='sk_test_emergent' is not a valid Stripe secret (Stripe replies 'Invalid API Key'). Frontend: full login → 2FA (dev_code auto-fills correctly from response) → all 5 tabs (home, tournaments, play, wallet, profile) work with proper data. Wallet balance ($460 after test withdrawals) and 2% fee calc verified live in UI. Deposit form, create-challenge form, notifications, leaderboard all render. No deprecated Expo packages. All testIDs present on interactive elements.

critical.issue: Stripe rejects the configured STRIPE_API_KEY='sk_test_emergent' as invalid. Stripe checkout session creation fails with 500 'Invalid API Key provided'. Blocks all deposit flows. Main agent must switch to a real Stripe test key OR use the emergentintegrations library helper for Stripe.

minor.issue: Applied fix: replaced 'otp[expires_at] < utcnow()' with _otp_expired() helper (see /app/backend/server.py:48). Was returning 500 due to tz-naive vs tz-aware datetime comparison. RETEST OK.
Recipient blocked: 'Undeliverable recipient'. Not a bug (test emails are random). dev_code fallback in response works, but production may need to allow-list or use delivered@resend.dev for tests.

rca_of_issue: TZ datetime bug RCA: server.py used utcnow()=datetime.now(timezone.utc) [tz-aware] when writing 'expires_at' to Mongo. Motor/pymongo strips tzinfo when returning datetimes (naive UTC). Comparing 'otp[expires_at] < utcnow()' therefore raised TypeError('can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes') → HTTP 500. Reproduction: POST /api/auth/register → POST /api/auth/verify-email with returned dev_code returned 500. Mitigation applied: added _otp_expired(otp) helper that promotes naive datetimes to UTC before comparison; replaced 3 call sites. Verified via pytest — all OTP tests now green.
